notes: Nordyne-family system, encoded independently from this page's own text only (no usesStylesOf: the page's sister list alone does not establish shared-system reuse, and no Nordyne/Benson rule is imported). COUNTING CONVENTION (Nordyne lesson, tested against this page's own examples): page positions are stated as 'numerical digits', but digit-only counting is FALSIFIED by Style 1's own example FGA030310579: its digits are 030310579, so 4th & 5th numerical digits = '31', which resolves to no year (1931 below the 1960 floor, 2031 future). Character counting decodes it (year '03' = 2003, month '03' = March), so character counting is this page's convention and is used for all three styles. Style 2 follows the same page convention: character counting gives 1999-05, while digit-only counting would give 2005-05; the convention is fixed by the Style 1 falsification, not chosen per style. Style 3's month is the trailing letter, chart-only, so it ships year-only. All three patterns are disjoint. See report for the Style 3 image-pass item.

styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [3,5] and [5,7]. Character counting (see file notes): '03' year, '03' month.

styles.era: 12-character serials, letter + digit + letter + 9 digits (dash variant normalized)
styles.notes: Page positions 4-5 = year, 6-7 = month (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [3,5] and [5,7] on the normalized serial (dash stripped). Character counting per the page convention established by Style 1: '99' year, '05' month. Digit-only counting would give 2005-05 but is not a live alternative once the page convention is fixed.

styles.era: 9-character raw serials (dash included), 5 digits + dash + 2 digits + letter; year only
styles.notes: Page: year = 7th & 8th digits (1st two numbers following the dash) = '97' in the raw form, i.e. normalized positions [5,7]; month = last (9th) character, a letter whose mapping is chart-only (FRIGIDAIRE-3.jpg), so month is null and the style ships year-only.
